title: Improve an existing interface without destroying it
prompt: Our marketing site works but looks dated. Improve it: better typography and spacing, modernize the hero. Don't break our brand (green #1B7A43, Karla font) or change any URLs. The repo is in ./site.

must: Inspects the existing stack/system and captures the BEFORE state prior to edits
Classifies scope as refinement: incumbent identity preserved, pinned brand tokens kept
Distinguishes error vs inconsistency vs debt vs deliberate decision in findings
URL slugs, nav labels, form names, logo, legal copy untouched
Incremental changes with before/after comparison per change
must_not: Replacing the green/Karla identity with the plugin's taste
A rewrite when a refinement was requested
Silent removal of sections or content
